shared_elements: tall vertical stone slab / pillar as the decorated field
low-relief carving on the face of an upright monolith
human-like anatomical or bodily motif in relief (hand/arm in B; figural glyph heads in A)
justification: Both are upright rectangular slabs bearing shallow relief carving, and both include a bodily motif (B shows a bent arm with fingers laid across the shaft, A includes small head-forms within its signs), but this is a generic correspondence of format rather than of content. A is entirely covered by a dense, regular double column of repeated rectangular sign-blocks read as a script-like grid, while B shows a single large sculptural figure-in-the-round arrangement — a belt/collar band, an arm and hand, and a projecting knob — with no repeated units or grid at all.
